_comment: 1화 「안녕, 나는 쿵쿵이야!」 컷 리스트 — 2차 개정 대본(docs/05) 기준. {이름}은 전체 묘사, [이름]은 축약 묘사, characters에 없는 이름은 fragments로 치환된다. speaker가 '나레이션'이면 화면 밖 목소리라 립싱크가 필요 없고, 캐릭터 이름이면 립싱크 대상이다. 영상은 MiniMax H3(OpenArt 웹, 무제한)로 만들고, 키프레임은 MCP로 생성한다. 이전 shots.json(128컷)은 1차 대본 기준이라 무효다.

sections.SC1: Act 1 · SC#1 남극의 밤 — 유성 낙하와 얼음 속 알
sections.SC2: Act 1 · SC#2 숲속 강가 — 얼음 알 발견
sections.SC3: Act 2 · SC#3 강가 공터 새벽 — 부화, 첫 파워, 이름
sections.SC4: Act 3 · SC#4 불어난 개울가 — 루비 구조
sections.EN: 엔딩 · 따뜻한 첫 만남 + 유성 복선

shots.speaker: 나레이션
shots.image: a vast frozen wasteland at night, endless blue-white ice cliffs meeting a black sea, a silver-green aurora rippling across the whole sky, utterly still and immense, epic wide establishing shot
shots.motion: The aurora ripples slowly across the sky, fine snow drifting over the ice, camera creeping forward

shots.image: the aurora sky above the frozen land suddenly split by a brilliant meteor streaking down, trailing golden-teal fire and sparks, the ice below lit up by its glow
shots.motion: The meteor tears across the sky trailing sparks, its light sweeping over the ice below

shots.image: extreme close-up of the meteor core burning golden-teal as it falls, jagged glowing fragments breaking away, sparks streaming past camera
shots.motion: The meteor core tumbles as fragments break away and stream past camera, glowing brighter

shots.speaker: 나레이션
shots.dialogue: 하늘에서 떨어진 신비한 유성 빛을 머금고
shots.image: the meteor striking the ice sheet, a blinding golden-teal shockwave blasting outward across the frozen plain, ice shards and snow thrown into the air, dramatic impact
shots.motion: The meteor hits and a ring of light blasts outward across the ice, snow and shards flying, the aurora flaring in response

shots.image: a huge crater carved into the ice, glowing meteor fragments scattered across its floor giving off wisps of steam, golden-teal light seeping through the surrounding ice walls
shots.motion: Steam curls up from the glowing fragments, light pulsing softly through the crater walls

shots.image: a colossal pale egg embedded deep in the translucent blue ice of the crater wall, golden-teal aurora light flowing through the ice and soaking into its shell
shots.motion: Waves of golden-teal light travel through the ice and sink into the egg, the shell slowly brightening

shots.speaker: 나레이션
shots.dialogue: 하나의 거대한 알이 숨을 쉬기 시작했어요.
shots.image: extreme close-up of the egg's surface glowing from within, faint veins of golden-teal light spreading across the shell like a slow heartbeat
shots.motion: The light inside the egg pulses once, then again, slower and stronger, like a first breath

shots.image: the ice crater seen from high above at night under the aurora, a single point of warm light glowing deep in the ice, tiny against the enormous frozen land
shots.motion: Camera rises and pulls back over the frozen land, the egg's glow shrinking to a single warm point beneath the aurora

shots.speaker: 나레이션
shots.image: a lush green forest riverbank the morning after a storm, wet leaves and puddles glittering in fresh sunlight, the river running high and brown, torn branches on the banks
shots.motion: Sunlight breaks through drifting clouds over the wet forest, water dripping from leaves, the swollen river rushing past

shots.image: [루카], [후안], [루비], [미미] and [티니] walking out of the treeline onto the sunlit riverbank together, splashing through puddles, cheerful morning mood
shots.motion: The five friends come out of the trees splashing through puddles, looking around at the storm damage

shots.image: [티니] bounding ahead along the riverbank with his nose to the ground, tail wagging hard, sniffing at the debris
shots.motion: The puppy bounds ahead sniffing the ground, tail whipping, then freezes and lifts his head sharply

shots.speaker: 나레이션
shots.dialogue: 강가로 나온 친구들의 눈 앞에 신기한 광경이 펼쳐졌답니다.
shots.image: a huge block of ice lodged against the rocks at the river's edge, sunlight blazing through it, something enormous and pale visible deep inside, the friends small beside it
shots.motion: Camera pushes in past the friends toward the ice block, sunlight refracting through it, water rushing around its base

shots.image: the five friends stopping dead and staring up at the ice block, mouths open, [루카] holding out an arm to keep the others back
shots.motion: The friends stop short and stare upward, [루카] flinging out an arm to hold them back

shots.speaker: 루카
shots.dialogue: 우와! 이것 좀 봐! 얼음 안에 진짜 커다란 알이 있어!
shots.image: close-up of [루카] pulling his aviator goggles down over his eyes and leaning in toward the ice, thrilled and amazed
shots.motion: The tiger cub yanks his goggles down over his eyes and presses close to the ice, eyes going wide

shots.image: extreme close-up through the sunlit ice revealing the curved surface of the enormous pale egg, {오로라빛} still faintly moving within it
shots.motion: The camera drifts through the clearing ice as the egg's shape resolves, a slow ripple of teal light crossing its surface

shots.speaker: 미미
shots.dialogue: 이상해... 얼음 속에서 따뜻한 오로라 빛이 흘러나오고 있어.
shots.image: [미미] adjusting her round glasses as she studies the ice closely, the teal glow reflecting in her lenses, thoughtful and fascinated
shots.motion: The koala pushes her glasses up and leans in, the teal glow moving across her lenses as she studies it

shots.image: [후안] waddling right up to the ice and pressing both flippers and his cheek against it, then flinching back from the cold
shots.motion: The penguin presses his flippers and cheek to the ice, then jerks back with a shiver and shakes himself

shots.speaker: 루비
shots.dialogue: 알이 추워 보여. 우리가 꼭 안아줘서 녹여주자!
shots.image: [루비] standing close to the ice with both paws pressed against it, her star wand tucked under one arm, warm concern on her face
shots.motion: The rabbit presses both paws to the ice and turns to the others with a determined, gentle look

shots.image: the five friends looking at each other around the ice block, nodding one by one, a decision passing between them
shots.motion: The friends exchange looks around the circle, each nodding in turn, resolve building

shots.image: the five friends moving in and pressing themselves against the huge ice block from every side, arms and flippers spread wide across it, sunlight warm on their backs
shots.motion: The friends step in together and wrap themselves against the ice from all sides, hugging it tight

shots.image: the riverbank at night, the five friends curled asleep in a ring around the shrinking ice block, moonlight and drifting mist, peaceful and tender
shots.motion: The sleeping friends breathe slowly together, mist drifting past, meltwater trickling from the ice

shots.speaker: 나레이션
shots.image: the first light of dawn spilling gold across the river valley, the sky shifting from deep blue to warm amber above the sleeping friends
shots.motion: Dawn light sweeps across the valley and climbs the riverbank, the sky warming from blue to gold

shots.image: extreme close-up of a crack racing across the melting ice, fissures branching fast, meltwater streaming down
shots.motion: A crack shoots across the ice and branches rapidly, water sheeting down the surface

shots.image: the last of the ice splitting apart and falling away in glittering shards, revealing the enormous pale egg standing free in the dawn light
shots.motion: The ice breaks apart and slides away in shining pieces, the egg revealed standing free

shots.image: the five friends jolting awake in the dawn light, heads snapping up, scrambling to their feet
shots.motion: The friends startle awake all at once, heads snapping up, scrambling upright

shots.speaker: 나레이션
shots.dialogue: 동이 트는 새벽, 마침내 알이 깨어났어요!
shots.image: extreme close-up of the eggshell cracking open with golden-teal light spilling from the fracture lines
shots.motion: Cracks spread across the shell and golden-teal light pours out through them, pieces beginning to lift

shots.image: the eggshell bursting open as {쿵쿵} pushes his head out into the dawn light for the very first time, damp and blinking and brand new
shots.motion: The shell bursts apart and the baby triceratops pushes his head out, blinking hard against the light

shots.image: extreme close-up of {쿵쿵}'s huge green eyes opening fully for the first time, the golden sunrise reflected in them
shots.motion: The eyes open wide, pupils adjusting, the sunrise blooming in the reflection

shots.speaker: 쿵쿵
shots.image: {쿵쿵} standing in the broken shell with his head thrown back and mouth wide open in a joyful first cry, golden sunrise rimming him with light, the five friends watching in awe
shots.motion: The baby throws his head back and cries out at the sky, birds scattering from the trees, golden light flaring

shots.image: {쿵쿵} trying to push himself upright out of the shell, legs trembling and splaying under him
shots.motion: He strains upward, legs shaking and sliding out from under him, wobbling badly

shots.image: {쿵쿵} losing his balance and slamming both front paws down hard onto the wet ground to catch himself
shots.motion: He pitches forward and slams both front paws down hard to stop his fall, the ground shuddering

shots.image: extreme close-up of {쿵쿵}'s three horns as golden-teal aurora light surges along them, brilliant and alive
shots.motion: Light races up the horns and blazes at their tips, aurora colors swirling through them

shots.speaker: 나레이션
shots.dialogue: 쿵쿵이가 땅을 딛는 순간, 뿔에서 시작된 신비한 오로라 파장이
shots.image: a visible ring of golden-teal light bursting outward across the ground from {쿵쿵}'s front paws, sweeping over grass and stones and past the astonished friends
shots.motion: A ring of golden-teal light races outward across the ground, grass flattening and springing back as it passes

shots.speaker: 나레이션
shots.image: the shockwave ring of light spreading out through the whole forest, leaves and branches shivering as it passes, birds lifting from the canopy, dawn sky above
shots.motion: The ring of light sweeps through the forest, every branch shivering in turn, flocks of birds bursting up into the dawn sky

shots.speaker: 티니
shots.image: [티니] tumbled onto his back on the grass with all four paws in the air, delighted rather than hurt, [후안] and [미미] steadying themselves behind him
shots.motion: The puppy rolls onto his back with paws in the air, barking happily, the others catching their balance behind him

shots.speaker: 루카
shots.image: [루카] stepping forward with his goggles pushed back up and one paw raised, beaming at {쿵쿵}, morning light between them
shots.motion: The tiger cub pushes his goggles up, steps forward and raises a paw, grinning hugely as he speaks

shots.speaker: 쿵쿵
shots.image: close-up of {쿵쿵} lighting up with the biggest joyful smile of his life, hearing his own name for the first time
shots.motion: The baby's whole face lights up and he bounces on his front paws with excitement

shots.image: the six friends together on the sunlit riverbank cheering around {쿵쿵}, broken shell pieces scattered at their feet, warm morning light
shots.motion: The friends erupt cheering and crowd around him, [티니] running circles, everyone laughing in the morning sun

shots.image: a swollen forest stream running fast and muddy after the storm, water churning over rocks, soft earth crumbling at the banks
shots.motion: The stream rushes past, water churning over the rocks, small clods of earth dropping from the bank

shots.image: the six friends playing along the stream bank in bright daylight, {쿵쿵} in the middle still walking unsteadily
shots.motion: The friends move along the bank playing, the baby triceratops wobbling along in the middle

shots.image: [루비] standing near the water's edge waving her star wand, unaware the soft earth beneath her is giving way
shots.motion: The rabbit waves her wand happily as the wet earth under her feet begins to crack and sag

shots.speaker: 나레이션
shots.image: close-up of the muddy bank collapsing away under [루비]'s feet, clods of earth dropping into the rushing water
shots.motion: The bank gives way and slabs of mud drop into the water, her footing vanishing

shots.speaker: 루비
shots.image: [루비] swept into the fast brown current and carried downstream, ears streaming back, one paw reaching up, panic on her face
shots.motion: The rabbit is swept into the current and carried downstream fast, thrashing and reaching upward

shots.image: the friends on the bank frozen in shock for a heartbeat, then breaking into panic and running along the water
shots.motion: The friends freeze for one beat then break into a run along the bank, shouting

shots.speaker: 쿵쿵
shots.image: close-up of {쿵쿵}'s face hardening from fear into fierce determination, eyes locked on the water
shots.motion: His frightened expression sets hard into determination, eyes narrowing on the stream

shots.image: {쿵쿵} charging down the bank on unsteady legs, faster than he has ever moved, mud flying behind him
shots.motion: The baby charges along the bank, legs pounding unsteadily, mud kicking up behind him

shots.image: {쿵쿵} skidding to a stop at the water's edge and slamming both front paws down onto the ground with everything he has
shots.motion: He skids to a halt and drives both front paws down into the earth, the ground buckling under the blow

shots.image: extreme close-up of {쿵쿵}'s horns erupting with brilliant golden-teal aurora light, brighter than before
shots.motion: Light explodes along the horns, blazing brighter and wilder than the first time

shots.image: {쿵쿵_파워}, the ring of light racing across the ground and into a fallen log at the water's edge
shots.motion: The ring of light races out across the ground and strikes the fallen log, which shudders and begins to move

shots.image: the massive fallen log rolling into the rushing stream and wedging across it, water piling up against it, forming a safe barrier
shots.motion: The log rolls into the water and jams across the stream, the current piling up white against it

shots.image: [루비] sweeping downstream into the log and catching hold of it with both paws, hauling herself against it, safe
shots.motion: The rabbit is swept into the log and grabs on with both paws, pulling herself up against it, gasping

shots.speaker: 루비
shots.dialogue: 고마워 쿵쿵아! 네 뿔에서 예쁜 빛이 났어!
shots.image: [루비] soaked and safe on the bank holding {쿵쿵}'s paw with both of hers, looking up at his horns with wonder, the others crowding around
shots.motion: The soaked rabbit takes his paw in both of hers and looks up at his horns, the others crowding in around them

shots.speaker: 쿵쿵
shots.image: close-up of {쿵쿵} ducking his head bashfully with pink cheeks, then breaking into a proud smile, warm afternoon light
shots.motion: The baby ducks his head shyly, scuffs one foot, then looks up with a growing proud smile

shots.image: the six friends laughing together on the sunlit stream bank, soaked and happy, steam rising faintly from their fur
shots.motion: The friends laugh together in the sun, [티니] shaking water over everyone, all of them recoiling and laughing

shots.speaker: 나레이션
shots.dialogue: 서툴지만 용기 있는 쿵쿵이와 소중한 친구들의
shots.image: the six friends walking together along a sunlit forest path toward home, seen from behind, long warm afternoon shadows stretching ahead of them
shots.motion: The six walk away together down the sunlit path, shadows stretching ahead, leaves drifting down around them

shots.speaker: 쿵쿵
shots.image: {쿵쿵} stopping and turning back with both front paws planted on his hips in his signature confident pose, chest out, golden afternoon light behind him
shots.motion: He stops, turns back and plants both paws on his hips proudly, his foot stamping down and puffing a small ring of dust

shots.speaker: 나레이션
shots.image: wide shot of the six friends small on the forest path beneath an enormous warm afternoon sky, the whole green valley spread around them
shots.motion: Camera cranes up and back, the friends shrinking on the path as the vast green valley opens out around them

shots.image: the camera high above the forest valley, the six friends now tiny specks on the path far below, distant blue mountains along the horizon
shots.motion: The camera keeps rising above the forest, the friends becoming specks, the far mountains coming into view

shots.image: the distant mountain ridge beyond the forest, and beyond it a single faint pulse of golden-teal light flickering once behind the peaks, easy to miss
shots.motion: The camera holds on the far mountains, and beyond the ridge a small golden-teal light pulses once, then fades

shots.image: an end card illustration of {쿵쿵} in his signature pose on a sunlit hilltop with the five friends behind him, warm afternoon palette, clear empty space at the bottom for a title
shots.motion: Gentle push in on the end card, light sparkles drifting, everything settling into stillness
